description: Ticket 07 capture matrix. Every path records the exact startup flags the planner produces, the login-shell decision the SSH transport applies before opening the terminal, and the field fidelity the path produces. Local paths are replanned for every recorded platform. SSH paths apply shellhook.RemoteCommandForLoginShell to the recorded login shell: zsh, bash, and fish keep the POSIX wrapper; xonsh, csh, tcsh, nu, and an unknown shell keep the plain login shell and use Tier 2/3. Verification is observed (a real shell ran here), manual (a real BSD or OpenSSH host is required), or planned.
fidelityLegend: tier is the capture tier. cwd/exit/duration: exact means a real shell was observed reporting that field; observed means a real shell reported the field but not the value; missing means the capture path cannot observe it; manual means this machine cannot run the path; planned means the behavior follows the design but was not run here. A manual or planned path may not claim an exact or observed field.

paths.name: bsd-local-zsh
paths.evidence: TestRealShellCapture and TestRealShellSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd (zsh on darwin); the BSD startup files are the same POSIX scripts.

paths.name: bsd-local-bash
paths.evidence: TestRealShellCapture and TestRealBashSourcesTheProfileAndBashrcOnce (bash on darwin); the BSD startup files are the same POSIX scripts.

paths.name: bsd-local-fish
paths.evidence: TestRealShellSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd covers fish when NETCATTY_TEST_FISH or fish is installed; fish is not installed in this environment, so the path remains a manual check.

paths.name: bsd-local-csh-unsupported
paths.evidence: TestPlanOnBSDPOSIXHostsInstallsTheHook (an unsupported shell stays unchanged); no real csh Session was run in this environment, so the prompt-derived duration is manual.

paths.name: bsd-local-tcsh-unsupported
paths.evidence: TestPlanOnBSDPOSIXHostsInstallsTheHook (an unsupported shell stays unchanged); no real tcsh Session was run in this environment, so the prompt-derived duration is manual.

paths.name: bsd-remote-zsh
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookKeepsTheWrapperForPOSIXLoginShells (fake SSH server with a real SFTP account probe) and TestRemoteWrapperInstallsEachShellAndCleansUp (wrapper run locally); a real BSD/OpenSSH Host is not available here.

paths.name: bsd-remote-bash
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookKeepsTheWrapperForPOSIXLoginShells and TestRemoteWrapperInstallsEachShellAndCleansUp; a real BSD/OpenSSH Host is not available here.

paths.name: bsd-remote-fish
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookKeepsTheWrapperForPOSIXLoginShells and TestRemoteWrapperInstallsEachShellAndCleansUp; fish may not be installed on the remote BSD Host, and no Host is available here.

paths.name: bsd-remote-csh-fallback
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookWithdrawsForNonPOSIXLoginShells keeps the plain csh login shell; TestNonPOSIXLoginShellsRejectThePOSIXWrapper reproduces the real csh Unmatched ''' failure. Remote fidelity is manual because no BSD Host is available.

paths.name: bsd-remote-tcsh-fallback
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookWithdrawsForNonPOSIXLoginShells keeps the plain tcsh login shell; TestNonPOSIXLoginShellsRejectThePOSIXWrapper reproduces the real tcsh Unmatched ''' failure. Remote fidelity is manual because no BSD Host is available.

paths.name: nushell-local-native-fallback
paths.evidence: TestRealNushellWithoutHookKeepsNativeCapture (nushell 0.116.1): native OSC 7 gives the cwd, the prompt mark gives a finish, and the typed capture has no exit code.

paths.name: nushell-remote-fallback
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookWithdrawsForNonPOSIXLoginShells keeps the plain nushell login shell; TestRealNushellWithoutHookKeepsNativeCapture observed the local native fallback. No remote Host was available.

paths.name: xonsh-local-hook
paths.evidence: TestRealXonshSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd (xonsh 0.24.2): on_precommand and on_postcommand carry the command, cwd, return code, and finish after the user rc.d startup.

paths.name: xonsh-local-native-fallback
paths.evidence: TestRealXonshWithoutHookKeepsNativeFallback (xonsh 0.24.2): OSC 7 at the first interactive prompt gives the cwd and starts the typed command at Tier 2. Xonsh emits no OSC 133 and its default prompt is not prompt-detected, so Session close leaves the exit and finish unknown.

paths.name: xonsh-remote-native-fallback
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookWithdrawsForNonPOSIXLoginShells keeps the plain xonsh login shell and TestNonPOSIXLoginShellsRejectThePOSIXWrapper reproduces the real xonsh SyntaxError. TestRealXonshWithoutHookKeepsNativeFallback observed the local OSC 7 fallback; no remote Host was available.

paths.name: remote-unknown-login-shell-fallback
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookFallsBackWhenTheLoginShellIsUnknown covers an absent SFTP subsystem or account entry; a real Host with SFTP disabled is not available here.
